'''Lucazec''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Originally known as '''Far Thanium''', it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]]. Lucazec was a potential candidate for one of the lost thrones of Xim.<ref name="Xim Week" /> After the fall of the empire in [[25,100 BBY]], it would eventually join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Lucazec was the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] world of origin. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" /> The Fallanassi fled the planet when [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]] tried to recruit them to the Empire.<ref name="BtS" />

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] conquered the planet while [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invading the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />
